name: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS)
directions: Self-report about how you have felt during the past week. For each statement choose the one response closest to your experience. Each subscale has seven items; use the supplied scoring guide and clinical context.

questions.text: I feel tense or wound up
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 From time to time; 2 A lot of the time; 3 Most of the time.

questions.text: I still enjoy the things I used to enjoy
questions.definition: 0 Definitely as much; 1 Not quite so much; 2 Only a little; 3 Hardly at all.

questions.text: I get a frightened feeling as if something awful is about to happen
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 A little, doesn't worry me; 2 Yes, but not too badly; 3 Very definitely and quite badly.

questions.text: I can laugh and see the funny side of things
questions.definition: 0 As much as always; 1 Not quite so much; 2 Definitely not so much; 3 Not at all.

questions.text: Worrying thoughts go through my mind
questions.definition: 0 Only occasionally; 1 From time to time; 2 A lot of the time; 3 A great deal of the time.
0 Most of the time; 1 Sometimes; 2 Not often; 3 Not at all.

questions.text: I can sit at ease and feel relaxed
questions.definition: 0 Definitely; 1 Usually; 2 Not often; 3 Not at all.

questions.text: I feel as if I am slowed down
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 Sometimes; 2 Very often; 3 Nearly all the time.

questions.text: I get a frightened feeling like butterflies in the stomach
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 Occasionally; 2 Quite often; 3 Very often.

questions.text: I have lost interest in my appearance
questions.definition: 0 Take just as much care as ever; 1 May not take quite as much care; 2 Don't take as much care as I should; 3 Definitely.

questions.text: I feel restless as if I have to be on the move
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 Not very much; 2 Quite a lot; 3 Very much indeed.

questions.text: I look forward with enjoyment to things
questions.definition: 0 As much as ever; 1 Rather less; 2 Definitely less; 3 Hardly at all.

questions.text: I get sudden feelings of panic
questions.definition: 0 Not at all; 1 Not very often; 2 Quite often; 3 Very often indeed.

questions.text: I can enjoy a good book, radio or TV programme
questions.definition: 0 Often; 1 Sometimes; 2 Not often; 3 Very seldom.

attribution: Zigmond AS, Snaith RP. The Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale. Acta Psychiatr Scand. 1983;67:361–370.
